overview: Tower Energy Diesel Optimisation addresses resource allocation is planned in silos, producing avoidable delays and occasionally infeasible instructions in telecommunications operations. The first proof of value uses tower loads, generator sensors and refuelling records. It produces a reviewed operational recommendation and a traceable decision record. The commercial success measure is fuel per operational cell site, established from customer baseline data before any improvement is claimed.

scope:
Delivery model: Redington or approved implementation partner, eligibility and staffing pending confirmation.
Duration: Discovery and design first; pilot and rollout durations depend on data access and scope; no fixed commitment.
1) Discover source quality and baseline: tower loads, generator sensors and refuelling records; define fuel per operational cell site and data-processing boundary.
2) Design control points, security and connector contracts; obtain owner approval from Network Operations Director / Telco Product VP.
3) Implement one bounded workflow, instrument missing-data exceptions and system-of-record write-back.
4) Test positive, negative, privilege, partial-data and rollback cases including replay disruption and edge cases with hard constraints enforced.
5) Review KPI in the pilot, document evidence, perform training and agree transition.
